query: begin; do $$ declare u uuid; p uuid; wr uuid; wf uuid; cr uuid; bk uuid; rm uuid; sup uuid; emp uuid; pur uuid; sal uuid; po uuid; per uuid; pr uuid; adv uuid; exp uuid; sm uuid; begin select id into u from public.profiles where email='alsndlmsn@gmail.com' limit 1; select id into po from public.production_orders where notes='QA أمر إنتاج' order by created_at desc limit 1; insert into public.production_materials(production_order_id,product_id,required_quantity,issued_quantity,raw_material_id) values(po,p,20,0,rm); insert into public.sales(warehouse_id,subtotal,discount_amount,crafting_fee,vat_amount,total,paid_amount,payment_method,status,created_by,customer_name,notes) values(wf,200,0,0,0,200,100,'cash','draft',u,'QA عميل نقدي','QA فاتورة بيع') returning id into sal; insert into public.sale_items(sale_id,product_id,product_name,quantity,unit_price,cost_price,discount_amount,line_total) values(sal,p,'QA-اختبار منتج محاسبي',10,20,6,0,200); insert into public.sale_payments(sale_id,amount,payment_method,cash_register_id,created_by,reference) values(sal,100,'cash',cr,u,'QA-REF-CASH'); insert into public.expenses(category,amount,payment_method,cash_register_id,status,created_by,description) values('QA مصروف تشغيل',25,'cash',cr,'draft',u,'QA مصروف لاختبار القيد') returning id into exp; insert into public.cash_transactions(cash_register_id,direction,transaction_type,amount,related_type,related_id,created_by,notes) values(cr,'out','expense',25,'expense',exp,u,'QA مصروف'); update public.expenses set status='approved',approved_by=u,approved_at=now() where id=exp; insert into public.employees(full_name,wage_type,base_salary,status,created_by) values('QA عامل اختبار','monthly',300,'active',u) returning id into emp; insert into public.employee_advances(employee_id,amount,reason,repayment_amount,remaining_amount,payment_method,cash_register_id,created_by,status) values(emp,100,'QA سلفة اختبار',0,100,'cash',cr,u,'approved') returning id into adv; insert into public.cash_transactions(cash_register_id,direction,transaction_type,amount,related_type,related_id,created_by,notes) values(cr,'out','advance',100,'employee_advance',adv,u,'QA سلفة'); insert into public.payroll_periods(period_name,from_date,to_date,status,created_by) values('QA فترة اختبار',current_date-29,current_date,'draft',u) returning id into per; insert into public.payroll_records(period_id,employee_id,base_amount,incentives,deductions,advance_deduction,payment_status,paid_amount) values(per,emp,300,50,0,100,'unpaid',0) returning id into pr; update public.payroll_periods set status='approved',approved_by=u,approved_at=now() where id=per; insert into public.cash_transactions(cash_register_id,direction,transaction_type,amount,related_type,related_id,created_by,notes) values(cr,'out','payroll',250,'payroll',pr,u,'QA دفع راتب'); update public.payroll_records set payment_status='paid',paid_amount=250,paid_at=now() where id=pr; end $$; commit; select je.source_type,je.source_id,round(sum(jl.debit),2) as debits,round(sum(jl.credit),2) as credits,round(sum(jl.debit-jl.credit),2) as difference from public.journal_entries je join public.journal_lines jl on jl.entry_id=je.id where je.description like 'QA%' or je.description like 'قيد فاتورة بيع%' or je.description like 'قيد شراء%' or je.description like 'قيد إنتاج%' group by je.source_type,je.source_id limit 100;
